title: Amit Yadav v. State of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Energy U.P. Lko. And 6 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
coram: Rajan Roy and Om Prakash Shukla, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed of; petitioner relegated to Executive Engineer under Para 6.5.
headnote: Electricity bills — dispute — U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, Para 6.5 — a consumer disputing electricity bills must raise the objection before the concerned Executive Engineer; the writ court will not examine the bills and the petition is disposed of with liberty to approach that officer.
facts: Amit Yadav filed a writ petition before the Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh (Energy Department) and six others, disputing electricity bills issued to him. He sought writ relief on those bills instead of first taking the billing objection to the distribution licensee's Executive Engineer. The Division Bench heard counsel on 1 May 2025. The order does not record the bill amounts, the period of supply, or the nature of the alleged error.

holding_units.holding: A dispute as to electricity bills is to be raised before the concerned Executive Engineer under Para 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The petitioner may approach that officer. The writ petition is disposed of without deciding the bills on merits.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the disputed electricity bills
not_decided.note: Left to the Executive Engineer under Para 6.5.
